limitations: Frozen retrospective research output; not live conditions or a validated warning
Source periods, populations, geographies and measurement definitions must remain distinct

measure.definition: Source-reported Number of forensic toxicology detections by original category and calendar quarter; categories overlap and do not represent unique deaths or people.
measure.calculation_method: Adjacent exact-period differences; percent change only for nonzero reference; complete-window arithmetic means; no inference or significance test
